text:
Anyone with Eco major, can you explain the prerequisite for Eco490?
Does it require a total of 15 credits of Eco courses?

Unfortunately, I missed my faculty evaluation for this intersession semester. I've two more courses left (ECO304,ECO490) which I've pre-advised for the upcoming semester.
Is there any way I can do faculty evaluation now? If I don't get the chance to advise for the first phase it will be tough for me to get these courses on 2nd phase.

Fellow Undergraduate Economics People,
After discussing further with a few senior faculties, the chair has recommended that we do ECO 482 (Model Building in Economics) instead of ECO 485 (Mathematical Programming) the next term. He has asked to gather at least 15 interested people for it to be offered in Fall '21. I am interested in doing the course to prepare myself for handling ECO 490 better.
Our department doesn’t always get the scope to offer important courses like this and so, I urge you to pre-advise the course.
You'll find the course description as an attached photo in this post.
Link to the course descriptions:
http://www.northsouth.edu/.../bachelor/bs-eco-old.html
From what I know, regardless of the curriculum, the course can be taken by anyone from the BS ECO program. I'm unsure if the BBA ECO people can take it as a free elective. Kindly email the chairman regarding that and if there's any prerequisite issue(s).
Email address of the chair: asad.priyo@northsouth.edu
Thank You and Stay Safe!
